claimed_coverage: Tests that Spanish datetime and age recognition correctly handles both accented (año/años) and unaccented (ano/anos) forms for decade expressions and age units.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix.patch modifies Spanish-DateTime.yaml and Spanish-NumbersWithUnit.yaml to add unaccented 'ano'/'anos' forms to regex patterns (DateUnitRegex, RangeUnitRegex, UnitRegex, SpecialYearTermsRegex, YearTerms, YearTypeRegex) and dictionary mappings (UnitMap, UnitValueMap, AgeSuffixList, AmbiguousAgeUnitList, LengthSuffixList), plus updates to C# definition files and test specs.
issue_context_used: The issue describes that unaccented 'anos' forms were not being recognized for Spanish datetime and age expressions, requiring pattern updates to accept both accented and unaccented variants.
notes: The eval.sh script was updated to regenerate Python resources from YAML pattern files before running tests. This is necessary because the fix.patch modifies the YAML source files (Spanish-DateTime.yaml and Spanish-NumbersWithUnit.yaml), and the Python packages use generated resource files. The resource generator is run for both recognizers-date-time and recognizers-number-with-unit packages, then packages are reinstalled in editable mode to ensure the regenerated resources are picked up. Additionally, all hardcoded /workspace paths have been replaced with ${WORKSPACE:-/workspace} to support configurable workspace paths for testOnly (WORKSPACE=/workspace) and testWithFix (WORKSPACE=/workspace_fixed) modes.
